$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the console's chrome strings (namespace `console::`): the shell, the palette, the switchers, the offline banner, the queue, the inbox, the realtime chip, errors and risk labels; Boundary: keys this app's components reference; page copy is `pages::`, document copy `documents::`, derived shortcut, enum and menu labels have their own namespaces; every Arabic plural carries zero, one, two, few, many and other; Runtime: browser; Governing contract: ADR 0294 d20 (derived keys), ADR 0234 d9, ADR 0080, ADR 0192 (ICU plurals)

palette.placeholder: Type a command, a page, or what you want to do…
palette.no_match_hint: Try a page name, an action, or describe what you want to do.

tenant.none_body: Ask an administrator to add you to a tenant.
tenant.switch_blocked_by_queue: Sync your pending changes before switching tenant.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: {count, plural, =0 {Changes you make will sync when you are back online.} one {# change is waiting to sync.} other {# changes are waiting to sync.}}

queue.title: Pending changes
queue.empty_body: Changes you make offline appear here until they reach the server.
queue.conflict_hint: The server changed this record while you were offline. Choose how to resolve it.
queue.discard_confirm_body: The change you made offline is deleted and never reaches the server.

attach.images: {count, plural, one {# image to attach} other {# images to attach}}
attach.product_hint: Search by SKU or name; the images go to the product of the variant you pick.
attach.done: {count, plural, one {# image attached} other {# images attached}}
attach.failed: {name} could not be attached. The other images were kept.
attach.unsupported: {name} is not an image the console accepts.

loyalty.title: Loyalty balance
loyalty.no_expiry: No points are waiting to expire

capabilities.permission_denied: Notifications were not allowed by the browser.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: The error was reported. Try again, or contact support with the code.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.body: The page may have moved or you may not have access to it.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: Ask an administrator for the permission named in the code.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.body: The service did not answer. Your change was not lost.

validation.title: Check the form
validation.body: A value was refused by the server.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.open: Notifications: {count, plural, =0 {none unread} one {# unread} other {# unread}}
inbox.empty_body: Order updates and messages for you appear here.
inbox.mark_read_failed: Could not mark the notification read. Try again.
